module.purpose: Provides the createAsyncThunk factory for Redux Toolkit, generating async thunk action creators with pending/fulfilled/rejected actions, abort handling, condition checks, and error serialization.
module.summary: This file implements the core createAsyncThunk utility from Redux Toolkit. It exports a factory that returns an async thunk action creator bundled with pending, fulfilled, rejected, and settled action creators. The implementation manages AbortController-based cancellation (including external signals), optional condition callbacks, request id generation, and serialized errors. Helper functions miniSerializeError and unwrapResult support error normalization and promise unwrapping. The file is heavily typed to support flexible thunk API configurations.
module.businessContext: Part of Redux Toolkit core; enables standardized async flows (loading/error/success) in Redux apps. Failure breaks async state management across countless React/Redux applications.

BaseThunkAPI
typeShapes.shape:
export type BaseThunkAPI<
  S,
  E,
  D extends Dispatch = Dispatch,
  RejectedValue = unknown,
  RejectedMeta = unknown,
  FulfilledMeta = unknown,
> = {
  dispatch: D
  getState: () => S
  extra: E
  requestId: string
  signal: AbortSignal
  abort: (reason?: string) => void
  rejectWithValue: IsUnknown<
    RejectedMeta,
    (value: RejectedValue) => RejectWithValue<RejectedValue, RejectedMeta>,
    (
      value: RejectedValue,
      meta: RejectedMeta,
    ) => RejectWithValue<RejectedValue, RejectedMeta>
  >
  fulfillWithValue: IsUnknown<
    FulfilledMeta,
    <FulfilledValue>(value: FulfilledValue) => FulfilledValue,
    <FulfilledValue>(
      value: FulfilledValue,
      meta: FulfilledMeta,
    ) => FulfillWithMeta<FulfilledValue, FulfilledMeta>
  >
}

units.name: createAsyncThunk

detail.name: createAsyncThunk
detail.signature: createAsyncThunk<Returned, ThunkArg, ThunkApiConfig extends AsyncThunkConfig>(typePrefix: string, payloadCreator: AsyncThunkPayloadCreator<Returned, ThunkArg, ThunkApiConfig>, options?: AsyncThunkOptions<ThunkArg, ThunkApiConfig>): AsyncThunk<Returned, ThunkArg, ThunkApiConfig>
preconditions: typePrefix must be a string used as the base for generated action type strings
payloadCreator must be a callable AsyncThunkPayloadCreator that returns Returned or a Promise of Returned
options, if provided, must conform to AsyncThunkOptions<ThunkArg, ThunkApiConfig>
postconditions: Returns an object that is callable (the action creator) with .pending, .fulfilled, .rejected, .settled, and .typePrefix properties attached via Object.assign
The .pending action creator dispatches actions with type `${typePrefix}/pending`, payload undefined, and meta containing arg, requestId, requestStatus 'pending'
The .fulfilled action creator dispatches actions with type `${typePrefix}/fulfilled`, payload of type Returned, and meta containing arg, requestId, requestStatus 'fulfilled'

The .rejected action creator dispatches actions with type `${typePrefix}/rejected`, payload of RejectedValue or undefined, error as a SerializedError, and meta containing arg, requestId, rejectedWithValue, requestStatus 'rejected', aborted, condition
The .settled property is an isAnyOf matcher that matches either a fulfilled or rejected action from this thunk
The .typePrefix property equals the typePrefix argument passed to createAsyncThunk
invariants: The returned object is both a function (the thunk action creator) and has the .pending/.fulfilled/.rejected/.settled/.typePrefix properties
All three action creators share the same typePrefix with consistent /pending, /fulfilled, /rejected suffixes
The rejected action creator uses options.serializeError when provided, otherwise falls back to miniSerializeError, for serializing the error field
The meta object in every lifecycle action always includes arg, requestId, and requestStatus
edgeCases: When options is omitted, the returned thunk uses nanoid for requestId generation and miniSerializeError for error serialization
When options.idGenerator is provided, it replaces nanoid for requestId generation when the thunk is executed
When options.serializeError is provided, it replaces miniSerializeError for serializing errors in rejected actions
When the payloadCreator returns a RejectWithValue instance, the rejected action includes the custom payload and meta.rejectedWithValue is set to true
When the payloadCreator returns a FulfillWithMeta instance, the fulfilled action includes the custom meta object
When options.condition returns false, a ConditionError is thrown internally resulting in a rejected action with meta.condition set to true
When the external AbortSignal is already aborted or abort() is called during execution, an AbortError results in a rejected action with meta.aborted set to true
When options.condition returns a thenable, it is awaited before evaluating the result
When the condition check causes an abort (via the abortController), the rejection takes precedence over a condition rejection

When options.dispatchConditionRejection is falsy (the default) and the rejection is due to the condition callback, the rejected action is produced but not dispatched to the store, though it is still returned from the thunk

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation is performed; an empty or falsy typePrefix produces action types with a leading '/' (e.g. '/pending'). If createAction or isAnyOf throw, the error propagates to the caller.

detail.ioFormatSpec: Produces three Redux action creators plus a matcher. Pending action: { type: string, payload: undefined, meta: { arg: ThunkArg, requestId: string, requestStatus: 'pending', ...PendingMeta } } with type `${typePrefix}/pending`. Fulfilled action: { type: string, payload: Returned, meta: { arg: ThunkArg, requestId: string, requestStatus: 'fulfilled', ...FulfilledMeta } } with type `${typePrefix}/fulfilled`. Rejected action: { type: string, payload: RejectedValue | undefined, error: SerializedError, meta: { arg: ThunkArg, requestId: string, rejectedWithValue: boolean, requestStatus: 'rejected', aborted: boolean, condition: boolean, ...RejectedMeta } } with type `${typePrefix}/rejected`. Settled: an isAnyOf matcher covering both rejected and fulfilled actions. The returned thunk itself returns a SafePromise augmented with .abort, .requestId, .arg, and .unwrap.
detail.summary: Factory that constructs a Redux async thunk: a callable action creator which dispatches pending, fulfilled, and rejected lifecycle actions around an async payload function. It returns the action creator with attached .pending, .fulfilled, .rejected, .settled matchers, and .typePrefix, and wires up optional request ID generation, error serialization, abort handling, and condition gating through the supplied options.

detail.name: actionCreator
detail.signature: function actionCreator(arg: ThunkArg, { signal }: AsyncThunkDispatchConfig = {}): AsyncThunkAction<Returned, ThunkArg, Required<ThunkApiConfig>>
preconditions: A valid `dispatch` function and `getState` function must be provided by the Redux middleware environment.
If `signal` is provided, it is an AbortSignal potentially already aborted.
`options.idGenerator`, `options.condition`, `options.getPendingMeta`, and `options.dispatchConditionRejection` are read from the closure of `createAsyncThunk`.
postconditions: On success, the `fulfilled` action is dispatched with the payload creator result, requestId, and arg.
On failure, the `rejected` action is dispatched with the error, requestId, arg, and optional rejectWithValue data.
If `options.dispatchConditionRejection` is falsy and a condition rejection occurs, the `rejected` action is NOT dispatched.
The returned promise resolves to the final dispatched action (fulfilled or rejected).
The returned object has `abort`, `requestId`, `arg`, and `unwrap` properties attached.
invariants: The AbortController's abort listener is always removed in the `finally` block if it was added.
The `rejected`/`fulfilled` action is always created with the same `requestId` and `arg`.
`Promise.race` between the abort signal and payload creator ensures aborts preempt normal completion.
edgeCases: If `options.condition` returns a thenable, it is awaited before checking the result.
If `condition` returns false, a `ConditionError` is thrown and a `rejected` action is dispatched.
If the external `signal` is already aborted, the thunk aborts immediately with `externalAbortMessage`.
If the abort controller is aborted during an async `condition`, an `AbortError` is thrown instead of a `ConditionError`.
If `abortHandler` is set, the abort listener is removed in the finally block to prevent leaks.
If `options.dispatchConditionRejection` is false and a `rejected` action has `meta.condition` set, the `rejected` action is not dispatched.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Rejected action containing the error and optional rejectWithValue payload.

detail.name: unwrapResult
detail.signature: export function unwrapResult<R extends UnwrappableAction>(action: R): UnwrappedActionPayload<R>
preconditions: action is an object conforming to UnwrappableAction with possible meta, error, payload fields
postconditions: If action.meta.rejectedWithValue is truthy, throws action.payload
If action.error is truthy, throws action.error
Otherwise returns action.payload

action.meta.rejectedWithValue false: payload not thrown via first branch
action.error absent: returns payload
action.payload may be of any type including undefined
detail.summary: Given an UnwrappableAction, returns its payload when the action is fulfilled and throws the rejection value or error otherwise, guaranteeing callers only observe payload on success.

detail.name: isThenable
detail.signature: function isThenable(value: any): value is PromiseLike<any>
postconditions: Returns true if and only if value is a non-null object of type 'object' with a 'then' property that is a function.
Returns false for null, non-objects, or objects without a callable 'then' property.
invariants: Does not invoke the 'then' property — only checks for its presence.
Does not mutate the input value.
edgeCases: null: returns false (null is excluded despite typeof null === 'object').
undefined: returns false (typeof undefined === 'undefined', not 'object').
Primitive values (number, string, boolean, symbol): returns false.
Objects without a 'then' property: returns false.
Objects with a non-function 'then' property (e.g. string): returns false.
Thenables (objects with callable 'then'): returns true.
Arrays: return false unless the array has a callable 'then' property.
detail.summary: Type guard that checks whether a value is a PromiseLike object by verifying it is non-null, of type 'object', and has a callable 'then' property. Used internally by other toolkit functions to determine if a value should be awaited as an async result.
